filters.name: Colorize by Border Distance
filters.shortDescription: Compute geodesic distance from mesh borders and colorize.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Store in the quality field the geodesic distance from borders and color the mesh accordingly.

filters.name: Colorize by Geodesic Distance from Point
filters.shortDescription: Compute geodesic distance from a given point and colorize.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Store in the quality field the geodesic distance from a given point on the mesh surface and color the mesh accordingly.

parameters.label: Starting Point
parameters.help: The point from which geodesic distance is measured. The closest surface vertex is used as seed.

parameters.label: Max Distance
parameters.help: Cut-off distance. Vertices beyond this threshold are assigned distance 0. Set to 0 to compute everywhere.

filters.name: Colorize by Geodesic Distance from Selection
filters.shortDescription: Compute geodesic distance from selected vertices and colorize.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Store in the quality field the geodesic distance from the selected points on the mesh surface and color the mesh accordingly.

parameters.label: Max Distance
parameters.help: Cut-off distance. Vertices beyond this threshold are assigned distance 0. Set to 0 to compute everywhere.

filters.name: Colorize by Heat Geodesic Distance from Selection
filters.shortDescription: Approximate geodesic distance via the heat method and colorize.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Store in the quality field the approximated geodesic distance, computed via heat method (Crane et al.), from the selected points on the mesh surface and color the mesh accordingly. As this implementation does not use intrinsic triangulation it is very sensitive to trinagulation. First run takes longer as factorization has to be build.

parameters.label: Euler Step Multiplier
parameters.help: Multiplier applied to the squared average edge length to compute the backward-Euler timestep. Larger values give smoother but less accurate results.
